templates.label: A pet dragon that breathes fire!
templates.phrase: a pet dragon that follows me and breathes fire
templates.say: Here comes your pet dragon! It follows you and breathes fire - but never at you.

templates.label: A giant beast you ride - when you jump it leaps, and the ground shakes when it lands!
templates.phrase: a giant beast i can ride that leaps when i jump and shakes the ground when it lands
templates.say: Here's your giant T-Rex! Climb on, then jump and it leaps way up high - and when it lands, the ground shakes and the monsters go flying.

templates.label: A creature that calls little helpers to fight for it!
templates.phrase: a creature that calls little helpers to fight for it
templates.say: Meet Captain Puff! When monsters come, he calls his little helpers to fight them - and they never fight you.

templates.label: A creature that throws fireballs at monsters - but never at you!
templates.phrase: a creature that throws fireballs at monsters but never at me
templates.say: Meet your fire buddy! It throws fireballs at the monsters - but never at you.

templates.label: A sword that shoots lightning!
templates.say: Your Lightning Sword is in your hand! Hit something with it and lightning strikes it.

templates.label: A huge castle with a lava moat!
templates.phrase: a huge castle with a lava moat
templates.say: Your castle is going up - with a lava moat all around it!

templates.label: A giant creeper face picture!
templates.phrase: a giant pixel art creeper face
templates.say: Sssss... a GIANT creeper face! Look in front of you!

templates.label: Boots that make you jump REALLY high!
templates.phrase: boots that let me DOUBLE JUMP!!!
templates.say: Here are your jump boots! Put them on and you jump REALLY high - and you land softly. A real double jump in mid-air isn't possible, so these jump extra high instead!

templates.label: A slushie machine - fill it with ice!
templates.phrase: a slushie machine i fill with ice
templates.say: Here's your Slushie Machine! Put it down, hold ice and pull the handle to fill it, then pull again to pour a slushie. 1 ice makes a small one and 3 makes a BIG one - add sugar too if you like! Here's a slushie to try.

templates.label: A LUCKY BLOCK - break it for a surprise!
templates.phrase: a lucky block that gives a surprise when i break it
templates.say: Here are your Lucky Blocks! Put one down and BREAK it - most of the time you get a present (diamonds, cake, golden apples, emeralds), sometimes a chicken, a pig or a zombie pops out, and once in a while... BOOM! Every one is different!

templates.label: A meteor that makes a crater!
templates.phrase: a meteor that crashes down and makes a crater
templates.say: Look up - a METEOR! It smashes down and leaves a giant smoking crater. Say undo and the ground comes back.

templates.label: It's raining chickens!
templates.say: It's raining CHICKENS! They float down all around you. Say undo and they fly off home.
